SPECIFICATION FOR PISTON RINGS FOR IC ENGINES 

PART I PLAIN COMPRESSION RINGS FROM 
30 UP TO 200 mm NOMINAL DIAMETER 

R- RINGS 



1. Scopa — Specifies the dimensions, tolerances, tangential loads and other details of R-rings (plain 
compression rings) from 30 up to 200 mm nominal diameter for internal combustion engines. 

2* Dimensions and Tolerances — Shall be as given in the Table 1 read along with Fig. 1 . 




DETAIL A 
SHOWING CHAMFERING OF 
INTERNAL EDGES (Kl) AND 
SLIDING EDGES (KA) 



F/G. 1 PLAIN COMPRESSION RING (R-RING) 



3. Designation — Shall include: 

a) Type of ring, 

b) Nominal diameter c/j, 

c) Axial width h^, 

d) Number of this standard, 

e) Material symbol, 

f ) Manufacturing process, 

g) Whether inside edges chamfered (Kl), and 
h) Type of coating. 



Example: 

A plain compression ring (R-ring) having a nominal diameter c/^- 90 mm, axial width h^^lb mm, 
made of S.G. iron heat-treated (A6), fully cam turned (F), with inside edges chamfered (Kl) and 
fully coated with tin (SN) shall be designated as : 



--/ 



R-Ring 90x2-5 IS: 8422 (Part 1) A6 F Kl SN

CO 









CO 



IS : 8422 (Part I) -1977 

4, General Requirements — Shall be as given in IS: 5791-1977. 

5. Marking — The rings which are to be fitted in a particular direction shall be marked with the word 
'TOP' on the top sides of the rings. For other markings reference should be made to IS : 5791 -1977. 

5.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of the series of Indian Standards on piston ring dimensions, tangential force, 
etc. IS : 5791 -1977 is a necessary adjunct to this standard which gives details of materials, surface finish, 
gap types and sizes, surface coatings, manufacturing processes, etc. 

In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the prevalent sizes in the 
industry. It is recommended that for new designs, only the sizes given in this standard be used. The sizes 
given within parenthesis are non-preferred and should be avoided. 

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from DIN 70910 'Piston rings for 
automotive engineering, R-rings, plain compression rings from 30 up to 200 mm nominal diameter', issued 
by Deutscher Institutfur Normung (DIN). 



Printed at New India Printing Press, Khurja, India
